task_description: In this multi-agent system, agents collaborate to develop a feature for a software application. The task involves writing code based on provided requirements, conducting code reviews, testing the implementation, and integrating the final changes into the main branch. Each agent plays a specific role in ensuring the code meets quality standards and is free from defects.
expected_outcome: If everything works correctly, the feature should be implemented according to the requirements, thoroughly reviewed for issues, tested against a suite of cases, and successfully integrated into the main codebase without conflicts or errors.

agents.description: Responsible for writing the initial code based on the feature requirements.
Reviews the code for adherence to coding standards and identifies potential issues.
Tests the code to ensure it meets the specified requirements and checks for bugs.
Integrates the code into the main branch and resolves any conflicts that arise.

content.test_result: Tests failed due to unexpected behavior

content.approval: Feature not ready due to errors
